result.summary: The intersection features marked crosswalks and traffic signals, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure. However, safety is compromised by faded pavement markings, long crossing distances without medians, and parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines at the corners.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners (lack of daylighting) block sightlines between pedestrians and turning drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection along the curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded markings with high-visibility continental-style crosswalks to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and prevent cars from parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

result.summary: The environment features a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks, but lacks signalization and physical buffers between pedestrians and traffic. The presence of parked vehicles near the intersection creates potential sightline obstructions for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corner may block the sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the curb near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Protection
hazards.description: The crossing is relatively wide with no median or refuge island, increasing exposure time for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the marked crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian crossing signs to alert drivers of the designated crossing area.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and traffic signals. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the environment is cluttered with utility poles and lacks dedicated pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Utility pole obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility pole is located right at the corner, narrowing the sidewalk and potentially obstructing sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground at the corner of the intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals which may not account for all turning movements.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection and crosswalk limit visibility for both pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the left side of the street approaching the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection with sidewalks but a complete lack of marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps. While a traffic signal is present, the wide, unmarked roadway and sightline obstructions from parked cars near the corner increase risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross at this signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The curbs at the intersection corners appear to be standard vertical curbs without sloped transitions for accessibility.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles are situated very close to the intersection, potentially blocking sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs approaching the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style painted crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all four corners of the intersection to ensure accessibility.
